entries.mem0ai/mem0: The official Hermes Agent memory provider offering a universal memory layer available via managed cloud or self-hosted OSS. It features multi-level state management for users and sessions using hybrid semantic, keyword, and entity matching with time-aware retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine with sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication. It automates fact extraction and user profile maintenance with native connectors for Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official AGPL-3.0 context database that uses viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to reduce token costs. It organizes memories via a filesystem-based structure and provides visualized retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph to automatically extract typed entity relationships. It includes a synthesis layer for cited answers and an autonomous dream cycle for overnight memory consolidation.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A learning-focused memory system that implements automated workflows for fact extraction, reflection, and consolidation. It offers a two-line LLM wrapper for easy integration and supports enterprise storage via PostgreSQL and Oracle AI Database.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A reasoning-first memory library that extracts conclusions from events and conversations using peer-centric modeling. It combines BM25 and vector retrieval to build stateful agents and serves as the upstream library for several self-hosted wrappers.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official memory provider that treats context as a git repository, allowing for branching, merging, and versioning of markdown context trees. It features a high-speed 5-tier retrieval system and integrates with over 20 LLM providers.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system utilizing SQLite for sub-millisecond retrieval latency. It is MCP-ready for clients like Cursor and Claude Code, supporting episodic memory compression and temporal knowledge graphs.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that uses structured traces and real evaluations to help agents master complex tasks. It generates persistent playbooks and distilled local models while integrating with the Pi runtime and MCP.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin that employs a hierarchical DAG for depth-aware session condensation. It ensures no messages are lost during compaction and externalizes large base64 payloads to optimize SQLite performance.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend that brings Honcho's memory capabilities to Hermes Agent for private cross-session persistence. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM or local inference server and includes a Docker-based setup script.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems using an open YAML engram format for data portability. It features local-first hybrid search with zero per-query costs and an activation-based decay model to automatically fade stale facts.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and secrets layer that provides portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and MCP clients. It uses SQLite for custody and includes tools to manually edit, delete, or reclassify context.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP servers and agent plugins, utilizing a hybrid of BM25, vector search, and knowledge graphs.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization tool that reduces prefill latency and token usage by up to 44% through prefix reuse and reordering. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: An embedded, self-maintaining memory plugin that provides explainable recall via 'why_retrieved' tags. It handles contradiction tracking and canonicalization in-process, requiring no separate server or GPU.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that consolidates temporal continuity, graph truth, and corpus retrieval. It leverages a multi-layered storage approach using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide bounded evidence packing.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses local-first storage via SQLite-vec and GGUF models, operating as an MCP-native server.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system that uses ranked graph traversal and edge-based relationships for semantic search. It includes automated indexing for codebases and media via OCR, guided by built-in reflection prompts.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A utility that reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select only the most relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard to track token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using an embedded .lbdb graph database with importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority memories. It supports BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A provider that enables durable cross-session memory and cross-agent recall via XMemo. It features semantic search with provenance and automatic session snapshots for memory mirroring.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that ensures complete deletion of events without leaving derived artifacts. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log for every operation and utilizes the Claude model family for on-demand summarization.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory. It offers tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first open-source design and prototyping system that integrates with Hermes Agent via a coding-agent CLI. It enables the generation of prototypes, HyperFrames motion graphics, and decks using a vast library of plugins and design systems.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A comprehensive library of 817 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to major industry frameworks like NIST and MITRE ATT&CK. It provides specialized capabilities for detecting cyber-enabled financial fraud and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: A utility that converts natural language descriptions into editable .drawio diagrams. It is particularly useful for visualizing codebase structures across Python, JS, Go, and Rust using a library of thousands of cloud and AI logos.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that enables the collective evolution of skills through automatic deduplication and quality improvement. It creates unified skill libraries that can be shared across team members and multiple devices.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: A content auditing tool that eliminates detectable AI writing patterns through a two-pass rewrite process. It utilizes a tiered replacement table and 49 pattern categories to remove structural and rhythmic AI fingerprints.
entries.wondelai/skills: A modular, cross-platform skills library compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compliant agents. Its frameworks are based on industry guidelines and can be installed via a plugin marketplace or npx.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically propose and generate reusable skills. It produces both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, manageable via dedicated slash commands.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: A type-safe implementation of the Agent Skills open specification for Pydantic AI. It employs progressive disclosure of metadata to reduce token usage and supports both programmatic and filesystem-based skill definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A suite of YouTube integration skills for Hermes Agent and other agents that extract transcripts, captions, and timestamps without needing yt-dlp. It also supports channel browsing and playlist extraction.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community-driven hub for browsing, searching, and installing skills with ARD v0.9 compliance. It ensures trusted transactions through Ed25519-signed bids and supports settlement via Stripe Connect and MPP.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: A set of skills that enables Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical prompts using custom 'prisms.' It includes seven validated prisms for simulation and optimization, along with a reflection tool to identify analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A workflow tool that transforms rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It offers Lite and Full modes and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running agents featuring a durable card model for tracking tasks and decisions. It uses local-first storage for easy diff reviews and implements QA gates to verify work before completion.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: A literate programming skill that weaves prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable code and automatically syncs edits between the source and the documentation.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A memory management system that uses markdown files for cross-instance shared memory. It captures high-value decisions to create a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: A set of agentskills.io-compliant skills for interacting with the Chainlink oracle network. It supports integrations for CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams, installable via the Vercel skills CLI.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: A tool that converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It uses AST analysis to extract verified function signatures and links instructions directly to source code line numbers.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Official skills for FLUX image generation providing standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2. It includes API integration patterns for webhooks and polling, supporting precise hex color and JSON structured prompting.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification featuring an OpenAPI-driven Python client. It supports recursive dependency resolution and monetization via TON and Stripe.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: An autonomous execution skill designed for complex, multi-step tasks that require real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes three-layer lazy loading to minimize token consumption for large toolsets. It maintains persistent connections via a socket-based daemon and provides a CLI for schema inspection.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: A Hermes Agent skill for managing Nextcloud files, calendars, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# / .NET implementation of the agentskills.io specification with MCP integration. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool loading.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like Discord and Telegram based on model capability. It preserves non-English prompts and tracks token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles to find bugs. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec for deterministic pre-scanning and uses an MCP server to reduce false positives.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent swarm that simplifies code by focusing on hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It uses a risk-tiered triage system to apply modifications and detects language-specific anti-patterns like N+1 queries.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: An intelligent skill retrieval system for Hermes Agent using a five-layer approach including FTS5, embeddings, and RRF fusion. It integrates via a pre_llm_call hook and degrades gracefully if optional dependencies are missing.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: A skill that automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and the agentskills.io standard, supporting protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: A collection of Nix packages that enables instant execution of Hermes and other AI coding agents via nix run commands. It ensures software freshness through daily automatic updates for all included packages.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Provides scripts and configuration guides to run agent CLIs, including Hermes, on Android smartphones using Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to grant the agent access to mobile hardware and user interfaces.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows desktop distribution featuring a GUI and 100 built-in tools across 20 toolsets. It supports local model execution via LM Studio and includes a dynamic tool maker for custom automation pipelines.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: A Termux-based installer that uses a one-line script to deploy Hermes Agent on Android and Ubuntu environments. This setup enables local model execution via Ollama integration and supports persistent memory on mobile devices.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: A community Helm chart for Kubernetes deployments that implements cloud-native state-safety guardrails to prevent concurrent write conflicts. It supports both direct deployment and operator-ready CRD workflows with optional gateway mode.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: A security-focused deployment that utilizes NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced sandboxing and kernel-level protection. It secures network and filesystem access while providing over 40 built-in tools and self-improving skills.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: A streamlined Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for custom builds using specific Hermes tags.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A NixOS module and package that provides declarative management of agent configurations and systemd services. It integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling and supports a hybrid approach for both Nix-managed and interactive installs.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: A production-ready headless deployment that configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for Ubuntu and Debian servers to enable the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane that allows users to operate multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities from a single web application. It features hierarchy-aware task delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.ellickjohnson/portainer-stack-hermes: A Docker Compose stack designed for Portainer that provides a ttyd web terminal interface for agent interaction. It automates the deployment process via Git Repository stacks and GitHub Action workflows.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration layer that manages multi-agent workflows across frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph. It features a zero-dependency SQLite stack and Aegis quality gates to ensure mandatory task sign-off.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: A TUI and PWA control surface designed for monitoring various coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It enables parallel execution across git worktrees using Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers for sandboxing.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A tiered architecture template that scales Hermes agents from a single VPS instance to orchestrated specialist teams. It utilizes a task bus pattern for delegation and includes bundled skills for security auditing and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: A level-based scaling template for Hermes Agent that facilitates the transition from individual agents to automated teams. It implements a task bus for orchestrator-to-specialist handoffs and provides skills for VPS provisioning and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms with support for over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenRouter. It provides visual org charts for team orchestration alongside durable memory and scheduled execution.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: A supervision hub for Hermes agents featuring a Kanban board to track autonomous task status and review queues. It allows users to monitor live reasoning streams and perform human-in-the-loop verification of all completions.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols. It provides a real-time Web UI to monitor agent dialogues and manage the task lifecycle via Hermes Kanban.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: A pipeline that coordinates 17 specialized agents focused on research, implementation, and infrastructure. It automates the full development lifecycle from bug fixes to performance optimization while enforcing mandatory security audits.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: A meta-optimization harness that uses an automated outer-loop search to refine agent code. It orchestrates TBLite and TB2 benchmark evaluations to track performance frontiers through candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena where autonomous AI companies compete for GitHub stars. It orchestrates nine agents using Paperclip and Hermes Agent, visualizing the competition via a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: An ACP-style delegation tool that routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool optimizes agent efficiency by providing a pre-indexed knowledge graph of code symbols and call dependencies. It reduces token consumption and tool calls by allowing Hermes Agent to navigate complex project structures through a high-performance MCP server.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A high-performance Rust TUI designed to visualize and track token consumption across multiple AI coding clients. It provides Hermes Agent users with real-time insights into usage costs and performance metrics through a unified command-line interface.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic, system prompts, and tool schemas generated by Hermes Agent. It generates structured diffs and self-contained HTML reports to help users debug agent reasoning and context changes between turns.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that transforms Hermes Agent into an autonomous CTO capable of managing issue triage and PR loops. It features 23 specialized skills for DevOps and security, allowing for project orchestration via chat platforms like Slack and Discord.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers a collection of community-driven CLI themes and skins to personalize the Hermes terminal experience. Users can customize colors, ASCII art, and UI elements using a flexible inheritance system that ranges from retro to cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port of the Hermes Agent brain and its 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel. It eliminates the need for external processes or OAuth, providing built-in support for MLOps tasks like vLLM inference and RL training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser that exposes page states and control mechanisms to Hermes Agent via the Model Context Protocol. It includes a supervisory UI that allows humans to monitor autonomous browsing activity while the agent interacts with structured page schemas.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that are restricted to specific folders with project-local memories and tools. It allows for seamless switching between global and local configurations, ensuring the agent operates with context-specific instructions.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during agent operations. It comes pre-configured with over 40 skills for finance and research, featuring an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: A rapid deployment stack that uses Docker to bundle Hermes Agent with LiteLLM, Ollama, and Qdrant for local GPU inference. It includes 29 community plugins for memory and validation, enabling a zero-cost agent environment using free models.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A deterministic static linter that scans agent configurations and system prompts for structural failure modes without making LLM calls. It uses HERM v1.1 scoring to validate tool descriptions and prompts across multiple file formats like JSON and YAML.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A dedicated migration utility that transfers personas, memories, and skills from OpenClaw to the Hermes Agent ecosystem. It automates the mapping of complex model configurations and credentials into the standard Hermes YAML format.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform all-in-one manager built with Tauri 2 for desktop compatibility. It provides a unified interface to manage Hermes Agent alongside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork app that unifies various agent CLIs into a single interface. It features automated generation of editable Word, Excel, and PPT files and supports remote access via WebUI, Telegram, Lark, and WeChat.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A zero-build web interface using Python and vanilla JavaScript that maintains full feature parity with the Hermes CLI. It utilizes a three-panel layout for efficient workspace file browsing and inline previews.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to simplify the installation and dependency resolution for Hermes Agent. It includes integrated management for 22 slash commands and 14 toolsets, supporting both local backends and remote API servers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A comprehensive web dashboard featuring multi-profile management with scoped memory and skills. It provides unified configuration for eight messaging platforms, including Discord and Slack, alongside local runtime performance monitoring.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a PTY terminal, Monaco editor, and a dedicated memory browser. It introduces Swarm Mode for role-based dispatch using tmux-backed workers and an integrated MCP catalog.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace that provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It features dedicated views for Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, with an embedded terminal for system repair and shell access.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard featuring the ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health tracking and Kanban pipelines. It offers a full MCP server control plane with log tailing and real-time streaming chat with tool call cards.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit that indexes transcripts locally without remote telemetry. It allows users to search agent histories and resume CLI sessions directly in Warp, iTerm2, or Terminal.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first Chinese desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust. It includes health diagnostics for the Hermes-CN-Core runtime and integrated rendering for LaTeX and Mermaid.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS interface specifically designed for Hermes Agent running on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud VMs. It features one-click automated installation on cloud computers and WebRTC voice mode via OpenAI Realtime.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for those preferring a terminal-based experience. It includes Kanban boards for diagnosing agentic work and TUI-based management of profiles, memory, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed as a Telegram Mini App with a terminal-style chat interface. It supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances and provides system monitoring for CPU and memory usage.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows desktop GUI that requires no admin rights or Docker. It bundles over 100 tools, including ComfyUI and MusicGen, and includes a dynamic tool maker for creating Python handlers and API wrappers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A self-hosted, glassmorphic web interface built as a single-file React 18 application. It integrates a terminal and file browser with real-time log streaming and management tools for cron jobs and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A configuration and process monitoring dashboard that tracks model distribution and costs in real-time. It offers searchable conversation histories via FTS5 and read-only inspection of custom agent skills.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring a chat-first interface with tool approval cards and SSE streaming. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and a PM orchestrator for managing streaming chat responses.
